command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_thermal*.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Two unit-thickness layers, unit cross section, insulated sides, k=(2,4), C=(3,1.5), omega=2.3. Set contact transfer Q=0.8-0.4i W, right trace=0.7+0.2i K and left trace=right+Q/2.5. At displacement d from contact, exact layer temperature is trace*cosh(b*d)-Q*sinh(b*d)/(k*b), b²=i*omega*C/k. Prescribe both exterior temperatures and compare all nodal complex temperatures, the contact power and the two integrated boundary reaction powers. CPU dense and sparse Q4, 8,16,32 elements per layer.
